_comment: Single source of truth for telling a talk or workshop apart from a career position. Read by src/lib/experience.ts (website, via Vite JSON import) and by scripts/html_to_pdf.js (PDF, via require). It lived as two hand-kept copies before, one TypeScript and one JavaScript, and they had already drifted: the PDF copy never knew 'keynote' or 'guest talk', so an entry titled 'Keynote: ...' was a talk on the website and a career position in the PDF. Patterns are lowercase regex fragments, matched case-insensitively.
